title: Endless Rise Textures
description: Some Textures & Music for Endless Rise Modpack!
body:
# Textures for some GUI
Endless Rise Textures is a resource pack created by the BMProjects team. Its purpose is to add in our Endless Rise: Remastered modpack some new textures that changed vanilla GUI. This need for more immersion in atmosphere of project!

## Mods Compability:
- Cosmetic Armor Reworked
- Crafting Tweaks
- Curios
- Quark
 
## FAQ:
Q: Can I use this resource pack in my modpack?

A: Yes, of course!
